stop_detail: task cap reached: processed 30 product pages; 3 navigation entries remain

coverage.denominator_source: https://www.skatepro.es/sitemap.xml product URL count at run time
coverage.notes: Discovery scope is the entry page's category grid, capped at 30 product pages; 30 valid products of 6665 sitemap product URLs. This is a bounded sample, not a full-site completion claim.

limitations: Static HTML only: Scrapling FetcherSession (curl_cffi) was sufficient; no browser was launched.
The task cap is 30 product pages; the category grid and the site sitemap contain far more.
robots.txt publishes Crawl-delay: 10 for meta-externalagent; this run applies 10 s end-to-start pacing to every request as the D01 S2 boundary requires.
Prices come from the page's embedded variant feed (price_number) and take the lowest finite positive variant price; compare-at prices, shipping and bundles are ignored.
No tax-inclusive/exclusive statement exists in the static HTML, so tax_basis stays unknown_not_stated.
Options are the public variant dimensions; all SKU combinations were not enumerated as separate products.
The 'Piezas compatibles' cross-sell block and customer reviews are excluded from description_html.

The site shows a 'Delivery to United States' suggestion because of the egress IP; quotes stay EUR and JSON-LD shipping/return policies target ES. No delivery-country cookie was set and no currency conversion was performed.
429 handling waits for Retry-After up to 60 s, retries at most 3 attempts, then stops the run.
sitemap.xml declares 6665 product URLs; it is a site-level denominator, not this bounded category scope.
discovery used 1 category page(s) and kept 30 unique products within the 30-page cap.
